dominant: vīra with adbhuta weight (bold application; wonder at ubiquity)
sthayibhava: utsāha (resolve to apply) steadied into dhṛti
justification: The ahnika dares — no rule, forbidden libation, doubt scorned — and each daring lands; wonder at the path standing everywhere (pot to cosmos) crowns the resolve, and the propagation command sends it onward.
